v1.95.0 — the small release: the box proves its own claims (one guard registry, two run
points) and a stranger's first hour works. Plan f015ba71c711 LOCKED 2026-09-06 02:03Z by Mike
from argo-os (sixth attempt; five refusals recorded on the plan), 3 of 3 members, fan-in
digest 5d28e56f00e3...; release activation f015637f34b1; activation root f015a9a2b714;
run f015af4a6a0a; release entry f015f80f5bfc. Release driver and independent validator:
Metis G122. Resident in argo-os: Argus A172.

THE ORDER (the tool's, not the driver's assumption; the first candidate invocation refused
at the release-leg wait because the run was locked and never bootstrapped):
  LOCK -> BOOTSTRAP -> fan-in validation (metis) -> open doc + test legs (argus) ->
  legs settle (Orpheus doc, Vela test: terminal, or a typed leg-attestation naming THIS run
  and the tested 40-hex sha) -> BUILD candidate #1 (argus, tropo-build-release.py
  --target 1.95.0 --activation-uid f015637f34b1) -> STAGE -> PREFLIGHT -> the four
  instruments on the shipping bytes -> [CHECKPOINT: Vela's AC9/AC8/AC5 walks on the
  candidate; Orpheus's cold read of the shipped root docs; Vela's read of CHANGELOG +
  KNOWN-LIMITATIONS] -> FREEZE -> FIRE from argo-os, Mike's gesture.

BUILD FROM main AT A NAMED SHA (one agent one clone, Mike-locked 2026-09-03): the build sha
is named on the bus before the build; anything after it is v1.96 by construction. Content
gates already at zero on 1e2ff2776: doc-currency-candidate-gate 0 (three measurers),
[1.95.0] CHANGELOG entry and KNOWN-LIMITATIONS v1.95 on main at 73a5ebb47.

FREEZE RULE (Mike, 2026-09-01): a finding blocks the fire only if one sentence names
irreversible harm to a customer or a false claim in what ships; everything else goes to the
1.96 inbox, disclosed. RATCHET (plan): mike_gestures_max 3, ignition_to_fire_minutes_max 30,
repeat_class_refusals_max 0, build_attempts_max 2, sealed_candidates_max 1. The founder
gesture ledger is kept honestly on the plan and published beside the version: the lock
alone cost six commands and one hand edit.

STANDING RULE FROM TONIGHT (Mike, at the fifth refusal): no command reaches the founder
until its own check pass has been run by the agent handing it over
(scripts/release-lock-dryrun.py is the first instance; --dry-run on this runner is the second).
